page_title: HOF 0-1 UNI | Hoffenheim v Union Berlin 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim) is penalised for a foul. Robert Hartmann had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Pavel Kaderabek is replaced by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' The booking goes to Diogo Leite (Union Berlin).
89' Oliver Baumann pulls off a great save to deny Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
88' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) takes a mid-range free kick and his beautiful strike only rattles the right post.
86' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) picked up a yellow card from referee.
84' 0 - 1 Goal! Yorbe Vertessen plays a pass to the feet of Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 0:1.
81' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Ihlas Bebou and he is replaced by Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim).
81' Nenad Bjelica has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) replacing Robin Gosens.
81' It is time for a substitution. Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is on for Christopher Trimmel.
78' The resulting corner from Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) is cleared.
78' This shall not pass! Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Hoffenheim have a corner.

74' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.

71' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
67' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes it short.
66' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aissa Laidouni.
66' Nenad Bjelica decides to make a substitution. Benedict Hollerbach will be replaced by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
65' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
61' Good movement by Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
59' The attendance for today's match is 18000.
59' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) sprays a pass out to Wout Weghorst, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
56' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

55' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Hoffenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim win a corner kick.
54' Hoffenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

54' A sweet pass finds Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Frederik Ronnow is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Hoffenheim will take a corner kick.

53' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Christopher Trimmel, but he hits a shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.

50' A precise cross towards the penalty spot was latched onto by Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
49' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

47' Hoffenheim slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' That's the end of the game for Umut Tohumcu, who is replaced by Robert Skov (Hoffenheim).
46' Referee Robert Hartmann blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+13' The match has reached half-time.
45+12' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45+11' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+9' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) has tested the patience of referee Robert Hartmann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+5' RED CARD! Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Robert Hartmann. He can have an early bath.

45+3' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle and Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
45' 12 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
44' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
44' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
37' The game is interrupted.
33' The Hoffenheim players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
32' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
29' Pellegrino Matarazzo is forced to make a change. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is unable to continue due to injury, Wout Weghorst comes on.
29' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) has a goal ruled out for offside!
27' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
26' The game is interrupted now, Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
22' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
22' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
21' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
19' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
18' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
17' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.

14' The Union Berlin players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball is behind the touchline and Hoffenheim will take a throw-in.

11' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
8' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) commits a rough foul. Robert Hartmann stops the game and makes a call.
6' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is substituted due to injury. Nenad Bjelica gives a chance to Alex Kral.
3' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) squandered a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but only placed the ball against the left post!
2' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Frederik Ronnow is alert and denies him.
1' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Union Berlin will kick-off.
Robert Hartmann will supervise the game today.
